summary: UP Fintech Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results on June 2, 2026. The filing reports quarterly revenue of $154.9 million (up 26.3% YoY) and a net loss of $26.9 million versus net income of $30.4 million a year ago, alongside a $59.7 million regulatory penalty from the CSRC. The company added 28,900 funded accounts and total client assets reached $58.9 billion. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event such as M&A, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing does not contain any deal terms or structural changes.
